source: User-supplied floral wallpaper and ornate oval hero reference
prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Create a full-bleed wallpaper texture for an eighteenth-birthday invitation hero, inspired by the provided romantic vintage floral wallpaper reference. ONLY wallpaper, no oval frame, no central panel, no text, no logo. Delicate climbing rose vines and pink roses over a clean white background, with muted lavender and purple leaves and stems instead of the reference's green. Pink, purple and white are the exclusive dominant palette. Watercolor/printed vintage botanical detail, airy repeat-like distribution, small to medium motifs with enough white breathing room. Landscape 3:2 composition, edge to edge pattern, refined fine-art stationery.
